request.initial_prompt: Yes, I did eat $8.74, all told; but I should not thus unblushingly publish my guilt, if I did not know that most of my readers were equally guilty with myself, and that their deeds would look no better in print. The next year I sometimes caught a mess of fish for my dinner, and once I went so far as to slaughter a woodchuck which ravaged my bean-field,—effect his transmigration, as a Tartar would say,—and devour him, partly for experiment's sake; but though it afforded me a momentary enjoyment, notwithstanding a musky flavor, I saw that the longest use would not make that a good practice, however it might seem to have your woodchucks ready dressed by the village butcher.

raw_segments.text: Yes, I did eat $8.74, all told, but I should not thus unblushingly publish my guilt, if
I did not know that most of my readers were equally guilty with myself, and that their
deeds would look no better in print.
The next year I sometimes caught a mess of fish for my dinner, and once I went so far
as to slaughter a woodchuck which ravaged my bean-field,—effect his transmigration,
as a Tartar would say,—and devour him, partly for experiment's sake.
But though it afforded me a momentary enjoyment, notwithstanding a musky flavor, I saw that
the longest use would not make that a good practice, however it might seem to have your
woodchucks ready dressed by the village butcher.
